task: Introduce yourself briefly: your name, where you live, and one hobby (2–3 sentences).
task_fi: Esittele itsesi lyhyesti: nimi, asuinpaikka ja yksi harrastus (2–3 lausetta).
model_answer: Hi! My name is Jeremia and I live in Jyväskylä. In my free time I like playing football and photography.

task: Write a short message to a colleague suggesting a meeting next week (2–3 sentences).
task_fi: Kirjoita lyhyt viesti kollegalle, jossa ehdotat kokousta ensi viikolle (2–3 lausetta).
model_answer: Hi Anna! Could we book a meeting next week to discuss the project? What suits you best, Tuesday or Wednesday?

task: Reply to a customer's email: thank them and promise to get back to them.
task_fi: Vastaa asiakkaan sähköpostiin: kiitä viestistä ja lupaa palata asiaan.
hints: I will get back to you
model_answer: Thank you for your email! I have received your question and will get back to you as soon as possible, by Friday at the latest.

task: Describe your field (IT) and your future profession (3–4 sentences).
task_fi: Kuvaile omaa alaasi (IT) ja tulevaa ammattiasi (3–4 lausetta).
model_answer: I study information technology and I am especially interested in programming. In the future I want to work as a software developer. Then I get to build software and solve problems every day.
